# REA: Reverse Engineer Anything
### One MCP for reverse engineering across binaries, applications, and runtime behavior.
**See a feature you like. Understand how it works, down to the binary level.**
**Website · Guides · Showcases**
Quick start · How REA works · What you can analyze · Showcases · FAQ · Documentation
npx rea-agents setup

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Get REA from morluto/rea,
> reareverse.com, or the rea-agents npm package.
> Follow

the installation and release links from these official sources. A similar
> repository name or copi
ed README does not establish that a download is official.
Join the Reverse Engineering Community
Discord · Q&A · Show and Tell
See a feature in an app that you want in your own product? Ask your agent to investigate it with REA
. It can inspect the app without its source code, explain how the feature works, show the evidence,
and build a version for your project.
REA connects your agent to tools for inspecting native binaries, JavaScript and Electron apps, .NET
assemblies, and websites. You can also use the same tools from your terminal. Analysis runs locally,
and results include the evidence and limitations behind each conclusion.
Setup registers REA with your agent and installs matching workflow instructions. Native analysis can
use an existing Hopper, Ghidra, or IDA installation; setup can optionally install Hopper with appro
val. Static JavaScript analysis needs no native analysis engine.
> **Visit the REA website** for setup instructions, illustrated guides, and real case studies.

## What you can analyze

REA requires Node.js 22.x (>=22.19), 24.x (>=24.11), or 26+, plus npm.
Additional tools and host sup
port depend on the target:
| Target                 | What REA returns
| Requirements and guide
| Native binaries        | Pseudocode, assembly, strings, symbols, calls and references
| Hopper, Ghidra or IDA; native analysis

|
| Offline ELF layout     | Sections, segments, original symbols/relocations and st
atic mitigation candidates    | Caller-supplied pwntools on Linux x64; binary diagnostics

|
| Go binaries            | Embedded compiler version, modules,
replacements and build settings                  | Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; n

o Go installation required                                                            |
| Rust binar
ies          | Embedded cargo-auditable crate names, versions, sources and dependency edges
| Built-in static ELF/PE/thin Mach-O inspection; Rust binaries

|
| WASM artifact          | Validation, sections, exact import/export WAT forms and deco
ded WAT                  | Caller-supplied WABT 1.0.42; `inspect_wasm_artifact`

|
| EVM bytecode           | Dispatch s
electors, byte offsets, inferred arguments and mutability                  | Local raw/hex carrier o

n Linux x64; offline EVM guide                                                         |
| SQLite da
tabases       | Tables, columns, indexes, views, triggers and selected ordinary-table rows
| Local database/WAL snapshot; Node.js 24.x >=24.15 or 26+ with native SQLite limits

|
